scope: Current working tree; scoped metric discovery and MCP tools

skip_reasons: uvloop is not supported/installed on this platform

data.origin: Repository synthetic fixtures and temporary real SQLite
data.method: REST/MCP metadata, SQL and result parity; real JWT and ASGI MCP requests

verified: REST discovery requires an explicit domain/database and authenticated operator.
One binding only; no catalog path, other bindings or credentials in discovery output.
Configuration evidence is not schema/business certification.
New HTTP MCP tools require valid operator JWT even when the factory trusts local calls.
Local in-process calls default to denied and require explicit host trust.
Token and host-trust flags are not tool parameters; extra parameters are rejected by FastMCP.
MCP metric_query defaults to validation only and shares fixed resolve/validate/execute service.
MCP row projection caps at 100 with accurate truncation; candidates omit execution rows.
Unknown/out-of-scope/version-stale requests fail; zero provider calls.
Real resource gates produce timeout/capacity errors; cancellation propagates and capacity recovers.
Legacy nl_query projection and error contracts remain covered by regression tests.
limitations: No real network listener, external MCP client, TLS/proxy/OAuth or separate stdio subprocess acceptance.
Existing five MCP tools retain their prior access policy; this is not server-wide auth hardening.
Shared-worker metric catalog sealing is not implemented; metric plan/discovery remain blocked there.
No cross-table/time-grain, tenant isolation or subagent metric actions.
No Snowflake or other external database execution acceptance; no business sign-off or production capacity baseline.
Original .venv remains unmodified; pinned environment supplies the verification evidence.
